'''Larcet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who fancied himself an antiquities collector. He hired treasure hunters to retrieve a hoard of artifacts that he learned of from a "trustworthy source," though the source unsuccessfully attempted to betray the Moff.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
In a newer update of the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the description of the crewskill describes Larcet as [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] instead of a Moff.<ref name="Dream">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|A Colonel's Dream}}</ref>
